title: Beef Flatladen Recipe – Easy Rouladen-Style German Dish by Oma
ldName: Beef Flatladen Recipe – Easy Rouladen-Style German Dish by Oma
ldInstructionsRaw: Cut the meat into pieces, about 2 to 3 inches square and about ¾ inch thick.
Heat 2 tablespoons butter in a large skillet. Brown meat well on all sides in batches without crowding. Add extra butter if needed.
Once meat is browned, add bacon and onion and brown briefly.
Slowly add some hot water and gently stir to loosen browned bits at the bottom of the pan.
Return meat to skillet along with any juices. Add pickle slices and enough water to almost cover the meat. Bring to a simmer and cover.
Simmer for 1 to 2 hours, depending on the cut of beef, until tender. Remove bacon before serving.
To thicken the gravy, combine 2 to 3 tablespoons cornstarch in a little cold water. Stir into the cooking liquid until slightly thickened.
Season the gravy to taste with salt and freshly ground pepper.
